$comment: Fleetwood (custom windows and doors, Fleetwood Windows & Doors) runs a server-rendered site with product pages under /products/<line>/<series>/ and /en-us/products/<series>. The product name is the h1, the description is the meta description, and the specifications are a Standard Features table of name and value rows (25 pairs on the sample: finish, glass, hardware, and so on). The site does not show prices (dealer quotes), so price is not configured and every product returns price.state unknown with a PRICE_MISSING warning; price_unit usd only keeps currency USD. There is no product image in the markup and no stock signal. Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title, description and 25 specs; browser: ACCESS_DENIED; ai-crawler-avalai: ACCESS_DENIED; duckduckgo, mojeek, yandex, yahoo and brave were not needed for this site's data. So http is the only route that works and is selected. Checked against the saved (curl) Series 3070 page on 2026-11-19.
